vsam.why: Source/ZECSFILE.idcams: INDEXED KEYS(16 0) RECORDSIZE(100 32700); the CSD's DEFINE FILE(ZC@ID@FILE) DSNAME is @ECS_HLQ@.ZC@ID@FILE.@ENVIRONMENT@ and the engine does not read the IDCAMS job as a define. The CSD defines it RECORDFORMAT(V); every record the case seeds is the one length reclen, so the stub's fixed-length records stand in (the program reads INTO ZF-RECORD, 32700 bytes)

Source/ZECSKEY.idcams: INDEXED KEYS(255 0) RECORDSIZE(512 512); the CSD's DEFINE FILE(ZC@ID@KEY) DSNAME is @ECS_HLQ@.ZC@ID@KEY.@ENVIRONMENT@, not read as a define (RECORDFORMAT(V) there, fixed 512-byte records in the stub)

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-active-standby
scenarios.why: the delete-clear of the resources path (SDR): DOCUMENT CREATE / RETRIEVE of template ZC01DC ('type: AS' and the other region's URL), WEB PARSE of the URL, WEB OPEN / CONVERSE DELETE (path from URIMAP ZC01R, query 'clear=*') / CLOSE on the other region, the expired-record browse (ZC01FILE is empty here: READ GTEQ NOTFND ends it), then 4000: the WEB SEND of CR LF, status 200

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-https
scenarios.why: an https URL: URL-SCHEME HTTPS, port 8443

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-default-port
scenarios.why: no port in the URL: WEB PARSE gives the scheme's default (80)

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-other-region-404
scenarios.why: the other region answers 404: the program does not look at the status

scenarios.name: adr-resources
scenarios.why: CA-TYPE ADR (the other region's request): 1000 sends the response at once; the replication still runs

scenarios.name: adr-replicate
scenarios.why: type ADR on the replicate path: DC-TYPE is set LOW-VALUES, nothing is replicated

scenarios.name: sdr-replicate
scenarios.why: the replicate path: response at once, DC-TYPE LOW-VALUES, no replication; 4000 does not send again

scenarios.name: other-type-resources
scenarios.why: a type that is not SDR or ADR: no response is sent; the replication runs

scenarios.name: other-type-other-path
scenarios.why: neither type nor path matches: nothing sent

scenarios.name: expired-record-deleted
scenarios.why: the expired-record browse finds a record: READ GTEQ of ZC01FILE reads the first record, EXPRD1 (ZF-ABS a minute before the clock), so 3100-DELETE runs -- DELETE GENERIC of ZC01FILE with KEYLENGTH 8 removes both of its segments, DELETE of ZC01KEY removes its key record (ZF-ZK-KEY) -- and the browse goes on: FRESH1 (ZF-ABS an hour ahead) is kept, and the next READ GTEQ is NOTFND

scenarios.name: fresh-record-kept
scenarios.why: the browse reads a record that has not expired (FRESH1, ZF-ABS an hour ahead of the clock): 3100-DELETE is not run, ZC01FILE and ZC01KEY are left as they were, and the next READ GTEQ is NOTFND

scenarios.name: expired-record-without-key-record
scenarios.why: an expired record whose ZC01KEY record is not there: DELETE GENERIC of ZC01FILE removes both segments of EXPRD1, then DELETE of ZC01KEY answers NOTFND, which NOHANDLE leaves to the program (it does not look)

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-url-unparsable
scenarios.why: #6072: the other data center's URL in the ZC01DC template has no scheme://, so 7000-GET-URL's WEB PARSE answers INVREQ (RESP2 28: no "scheme://", the stub's assumption); line 338 is true, DC-TYPE becomes ACTIVE-SINGLE, and 2000-REPLICATE's three EIBRESP tests (221, 226, 232) are false: no WEB OPEN, CONVERSE or CLOSE is issued

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-template-too-short
scenarios.why: #6072: the ZC01DC template holds only the 10-byte type line, so 7000-GET-URL's DOCUMENT RETRIEVE is NORMAL but DC-LENGTH is not greater than TEN (line 323 false, no WEB PARSE) and the third test of line 338 (DC-LENGTH EQUAL TEN) sets ACTIVE-SINGLE

notes: zECS's expiration clean-up task for one instance (ZECS003, started by the ZX## transaction, here ZC01: EIBTRNID(3:2) names the instance's files ZC01FILE and ZC01KEY, its URIMAP ZC01R and its document template ZC01DC). Its COMMAREA is CA-TYPE ('ADR' or 'SDR') and CA-URI-FIELD-01 ('/resources' or '/replicate'). The region's facts are stated on both sides: the document template ZC01DC as the document holds it ("doctemplates", oracle_assumptions.md X33, APPENDCRLF applied: 'type: <AA|AS|A1>' CR LF, the other region's URL, CR LF; zECS's own template is ZC##DC.txt), the URIMAP definitions ("urimaps", X32), the other region's HTTP server ("http_peers", X35) and the inbound request the WEB SEND answers ("http_request", X37). The files ZC01FILE / ZC01KEY are named by the program at run time and defined by zECS's IDCAMS jobs (ZECSFILE.idcams, ZECSKEY.idcams) with install placeholders in their names: "install_symbols" states the instance (ID 01) and each dataset's "runtime_file" states its IDCAMS key and record size (the seed files are written for this case: zcempty.bin, zcfile-expired.bin, zcfile-fresh.bin, zckey.bin hold fixed 32700- / 512-byte records, ZF-ABS counted from the case's clock). The twelve first scenarios browse an empty ZC01FILE (READ GTEQ NOTFND); three more state records, so 3100-DELETE (DELETE GENERIC of ZC01FILE, DELETE of ZC01KEY) runs. Not reached (refused by name): a template with no URL (type A1: WEB PARSE with URLLENGTH 0, X36, IBM leaves the condition open). EIBFN is not read on a path a scenario takes (the FILE-ERROR text only names it). Derived from zECS (github.com/walmartlabs/zECS, Apache-2.0): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

install_symbols.why: zECS's install jobs (JCL/DEFZC##.jcl, ZC##DC.jcl) replace ## / @id@ in the per-instance names (the CSD's ZC@ID@FILE and ZC@ID@KEY); they also replace @ecs_hlq@ and @environment@ in the CSD's DSNAMEs (ZECS.ZC01FILE.TEST style); this case installs one instance, 01, in high-level qualifier ZECS, environment TEST, so the transaction ZC01 reads and deletes in ZC01FILE and ZC01KEY (EIBTRNID(3:2) = '01')

compiler_options_why: #5089: the program MOVEs LENGTH OF ZF-RECORD (32700) to ZF-LENGTH, a PIC S9(04) COMP, then READs LENGTH(ZF-LENGTH): TRUNC(STD) stores 2700 there and every full-size record would be LENGERR (a record over 2700 bytes could never be read), so the program only works as shipped under TRUNC(BIN); ASMZECS.jcl's DFHYITVL step states no TRUNC option (assumption, register it)
